WITH filtered_data AS (
  SELECT 
    ab.translink,
    tr.ordertypedist,
    COUNT(*) as record_count
  FROM advancedbehavior ab
  INNER JOIN transactionrecord tr ON tr.transreg = ab.translink
  WHERE ab.peercorr >= 0.149
    AND tr.ordertypedist IS NOT NULL
  GROUP BY ab.translink, tr.ordertypedist
),
totals_by_ordertype AS (
  SELECT 
    ordertypedist,
    SUM(record_count) as type_total
  FROM filtered_data
  GROUP BY ordertypedist
)
SELECT 
  fd.translink,
  fd.ordertypedist,
  fd.record_count,
  fd.record_count * 1.0 / tbo.type_total as fraction
FROM filtered_data fd
JOIN totals_by_ordertype tbo ON tbo.ordertypedist = fd.ordertypedist
ORDER BY fraction DESC
LIMIT 10;
